index_title: Exact CRT, finite lattice coordinates and guarded quotient descent
scope: Preparation for OTHER Lean projects: five source results and two auxiliary equations. Abstract commuting-equivalence CRT and finite order arguments are separate from the actual CCO exact instance and guarded typed descent. No Lean code.
scope_explanation: statement and proof. Set-level CRT, fine-colour readout and descent are distinct exports; no ambient automorphism lift or full-lattice distributivity is inferred.

assumptions.name: Abstract represented equivalences
assumptions.statement: Inhabited X and a sublattice of actual equivalences with pairwise represented commutation. Only finite families are considered; no ambient Id/Top membership, action, finiteness, SAP or CCO assumption.

assumptions.name: Finite distributive order setting
assumptions.statement: Finite inhabited distributive lattice for Birkhoff and source MI lemma. The finite-list MI argument itself uses only distributivity. No CCO, group action or exactness.

assumptions.name: Original one-sort source
assumptions.statement: Actual inhabited transitive homogeneous finite complete symmetric binary CCO source, original logical identity and represented RAW products. Exact equivalences are only a sublattice of the full invariant lattice. No SAP or Hasse input.

assumptions.name: Typed original source
assumptions.statement: Actual homogeneous source with finitely many named inhabited individually transitive sorts, finite binary palettes, symmetric same-sort orbitals and cross-sort converse. Use the explicit full RAW exact provider; no SAP, NR2 or mixed-sort commutation.

imports.name: lem:exact-product
imports.statement: Original RAW exact product closure and distribution over finite exact intersections with NONEMPTY RESULT. Same-sort actual composition, not STRONG multiplication.

imports.name: lem:exact-balls
imports.statement: Original same-sort different-centre finite exact-ball Helly, including equality-bearing exact equivalence balls.

imports.name: lem:exact-quotient-colour-meet
imports.statement: For actual exact quotient kernels, the fine orbital block at the meet is the intersection of their coarse orbital blocks; equality atoms retained.

imports.name: thm:full-typed-exact-balls
imports.statement: Full typed equality-inclusive exact convolution, nonempty-result meet distributivity and serial/Top laws; no mixed-sort commutation is part of the contract.

definitions.name: Permuting equivalence sublattice
definitions.statement: An inhabited X with a sublattice of actual equivalences closed under ambient binary meet/join; every pair permutes. Neither X nor the sublattice need be finite; ambient Id/Top need not belong.

definitions.name: Finite class Helly
definitions.statement: Every finite pairwise-intersecting family E_i[x_i] intersects. Repeated relations and centres are allowed; empty family means X.

definitions.name: Finite compatible tuple CRT
definitions.statement: For a finite nonempty list E_i, kernel K=meet E_i; tuples of X/E_i agree in each X/(E_i join E_j). The natural map from X/K is the object studied.

definitions.name: Actual exact invariant lattice
definitions.statement: All equality-inclusive word-exact invariant equivalences of the original one-sort finite symmetric CCO source; distinct from the full invariant lattice.

definitions.name: Finite Birkhoff poset
definitions.statement: For a finite inhabited distributive lattice Lambda, P consists of NONZERO join-irreducibles with inherited order; Down(P) is its downset lattice.

definitions.name: Selected MI coordinates
definitions.statement: A finite nonempty list J_i in a distributive lattice, K=meet J_i, and meet-irreducible L>=K. Properness of actual quotient coordinate L is separate; selected J_i need not themselves be MI.

source.anchor: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite distributive lattice

definitions.name: Actual quotients and two-factor fibre product
definitions.statement: Actual quotients of equivalences on a common inhabited carrier. For E,J let K=E meet J and Q=E join J; use the natural maps X/E -> X/Q and X/J -> X/Q. Commutation is a separate premise of the two-factor bijection.

definitions.name: Same-sort saturated source relation
definitions.statement: Actual exact equivalence J and nonempty invariant exact Q>=J with J;Q;J=Q. Preserve the source containment hypothesis; never use it alone as a saturation proof for a general relation.

source.anchor: Suppose $J$ is an invariant exact equivalence

definitions.name: Typed original kernels and actual quotient colours
definitions.statement: Named original transitive sorts and full RAW exact invariant kernels E_s on every visited sort. Name all actual quotient pair orbitals of the original group action.

definitions.name: Presentation-local intertwining
definitions.statement: Nonempty full exact D:s->t satisfies E_s;D;E_t=D and has a finite word presentation in which every occurring atom a:u->v obeys E_u;a=a;E_v. Empty restriction list means Top.

claims.name: Join/product and class compatibility
claims.statement: For permuting equivalences E,F, E join F=E;F. Classes E[x],F[y] meet iff x(E join F)y, equivalently their quotient images agree.

claims.name: Three-class Helly implies distributivity
claims.statement: The classes E[x],F[x],G[y] with xEy and xFzGy give E meet (F join G)<=(E meet F) join (E meet G); the reverse inclusion and dual law give distributivity.

claims.name: Distributivity implies finite class Helly
claims.statement: Handle zero/one classes separately, then induct using the nonempty meet of the first n-1 equivalences and finite distributivity. No ambient Top member is required.

claims.name: Natural coordinate map and exact kernel
claims.statement: For a finite nonempty list, [x]_K -> ([x]_Ei) is well-defined, injective and has compatible image. This uses no distributivity.

claims.name: Compatibility is pairwise class intersection
claims.statement: Every compatible quotient tuple supplies pairwise-intersecting represented classes and conversely.

claims.name: Helly gives finite CRT surjectivity
claims.statement: Finite class Helly supplies a real representative of each compatible tuple; with C04 this is a bijection onto the compatible locus.

claims.name: Finite CRT gives class Helly
claims.statement: Surjectivity for every finite nonempty list gives nonempty-family class Helly. The empty family uses X inhabited; no infinite-family assertion follows.

claims.name: Nonzero join-irreducibles are join-prime
claims.statement: In a distributive lattice p<=x join y implies p=(p meet x) join (p meet y), so join irreducibility gives a choice; finite joins follow, with empty join excluded by p nonzero.

claims.name: Finite join-irreducible decomposition
claims.statement: Induct below a in the finite lattice: bottom is the empty join, an irreducible is itself, and every other nonbottom a splits into two smaller elements.

claims.name: Birkhoff downset isomorphism
claims.statement: Phi(a)={p<=a} and Psi(D)=join D are inverse monotone maps by decomposition and finite join-primality. The one-element lattice uses P empty.

claims.name: Exact equivalences form a finite bounded sublattice
claims.statement: Finite pair orbitals give finiteness; Id/Top are exact, meets contain Id, and exact convolution plus original commutation gives exact ambient joins.

claims.name: Class Helly from exact balls
claims.statement: Classes of exact equivalences are actual exact balls at their respective centres, so different-centre exact-ball Helly applies. Support Helly alone is not the input.

claims.name: Actual exact distributivity and finite CRT
claims.statement: Instantiate the abstract theorem using C11 and C12; the full invariant lattice is not asserted distributive.

claims.name: Actual exact Birkhoff representation
claims.statement: Apply the internal finite Birkhoff proof to the exact lattice; no additional unexpanded external theorem is required.

claims.name: Finite selected-MI cofinality
claims.statement: Distributivity makes binary meet-irreducibles meet-prime; finite nonempty-list induction gives meet J_i<=L => some J_i<=L.

claims.name: Upward quotient-coordinate image
claims.statement: For an actual represented instance, inclusion J_i<=L gives the surjection X/J_i -> X/L. No fine-colour reconstruction or ambient lifting is inferred.

claims.name: Two-factor fibre-product set bijection
claims.statement: For any permuting E,J, X/(E meet J) maps bijectively to the fibre product over X/(E join J). No Helly/distributivity is needed for two factors.

claims.name: Separate two-factor fine-colour readout
claims.statement: For actual exact E,J and original atom a including Id, (E meet J);a=(E;a) meet (J;a); same-sort commutation identifies these with actual saturated orbital blocks.

claims.name: Actual typed orbital blocks and composition pullback
claims.statement: For an actual quotient orbital with representative atom a:u->v, its old inverse image is E_u;a;E_v. Quotient equality pulls back to E_u. This is a group-orbit witness calculation, not a homogeneity/lifting assumption on the quotient. Inverse image of composable quotient relations equals composition of their actual inverse images, by surjectivity of the intermediate quotient map. This elementary identity needs no exact-calculus provider.

claims.name: Full exact quotient pullback without intertwining
claims.statement: Surjectivity and saturation make inverse image commute with composition, retaining the genuine intermediate kernels. Atomic blocks, words and nonempty exact intersections pull back to full exact original relations.

claims.name: Same-sort projected word identity
claims.statement: For an old word, original commutation moves J through its factors, so J;P_w;J equals the product of the saturated atomic blocks. Empty word has saturated value J.

claims.name: Same-sort exact descent
claims.statement: For the nonempty saturated exact Q, exact meet-product distributivity writes Q as the intersection of its saturated word profiles, each a quotient-word pullback; hence Q/J is exact.

claims.name: Intertwining removes intermediate kernels
claims.statement: The TI law for every factor in the chosen word allows its actual quotient-word pullback to equal E_s;P_w;E_t. No unrestricted mixed-sort commutation is used.

claims.name: Typed exact descent from a TI presentation
claims.statement: Endpoint saturation, nonempty-result typed exact convolution and C23 give an exact quotient-word presentation for D/(E_s,E_t), including empty words and empty restriction lists.

tasks.name: Abstract finite CRT
tasks.acceptance: Prove permuting-equivalence compatibility, Helly/distributivity equivalence, the finite tuple map and two-factor bijection without model-theoretic hypotheses.

tasks.name: Finite order representation and MI
tasks.acceptance: Prove or reuse an exact finite Birkhoff contract; retain nonzero join-irreducibles and nonempty MI coordinate lists, then actual quotient maps.

tasks.name: Actual exact-lattice and colour instance
tasks.acceptance: Use distinct RAW products, exact-ball Helly and colour-readout imports; do not conflate the set CRT with pair-colour reconstruction.

tasks.name: Actual quotient blocks and pullback
tasks.acceptance: Prove original-action block inverse images and word/exact pullback, preserving intermediate kernels and quotient identity.

tasks.name: Same-sort and guarded typed descent
tasks.acceptance: Prove same-sort commutation and presentation-local typed intertwining routes; keep explicit endpoint saturation and empty-word/restriction cases.

controls.check: All equivalence pairs on a four-point set: two-factor compatibility surjectivity exactly tracks represented commutation.
Boolean coordinate CRT succeeds; F2² full M3 lattice defeats commutation-only CRT; a distributive noncommuting diamond defeats distributivity-only CRT.
Finite downset lattices: Birkhoff inverse maps and MI meet-primality, including the one-element lattice and empty-poset case.
Actual typed F2 source: endpoint saturation alone does not justify factorwise word projection; TI examples and quotient pullback retain their precise scope.
Nontrivial kernels distinguish quotient equality from real Id, empty-family ambient Top from a sublattice top, and containment from saturation of arbitrary relations.
